features.description: Add explicit fallback_models configuration, chain construction, transport classification updates, and fail-loud startup validation.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned agents resolve explicitly configured fallbacks after the head while unconfigured agents remain single-link
Exact idle and signal-killed errors are walkable while hard-timeout and git-push errors are terminal
Invalid fallback count, identity, resolution, harness, and price configurations fail with agent-specific errors
All 37 currently unconfigured agents preserve their chain head and runtime behavior
A documented fallback_models YAML example is parsed and validated by tests

features.description: Propagate the model chain and run one isolated fallback attempt inside the same Cloud Run execution only for transport failures.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic fake 503 on model A invokes model B once and succeeds without re-dispatch
Git-push and hard-timeout failures invoke only the head model
MaxInContainerWalks is enforced so a three-link chain executes at most two model runs
Each attempt uses a clean attempt-specific work directory
Single-link dispatch retains existing timeout and behavior with AILANG_MODEL_CHAIN equal to the pin

features.description: Serialize per-attempt history, bank terminal model/link attribution, forward it to completion consumers, and pin global execution bounds.
acceptance_criteria: Every cloud completion path reports terminal ModelUsed and ChainLinkIndex including link zero
Walked completions contain two ordered attempt records with first-attempt error and cost data
Completion handling banks and forwards terminal model and link attribution
Walked failure narration names both models and the first transport classification
Tests enforce the existing two executions times two model runs maximum
make test, make lint, and make check-boundaries pass
